description: Cash in E063's shallow epoch slope. Run only if the H4.1.2 extra-seed mean is >= 0.7535, or after a keep that banks >= +0.1 pp (H7.1.1, OLS, Polar Express). Base: the then-tip, else E058. Make one change: total epochs 6.75 → 6.5, with the 0.25 epoch removed from the 32 px stage. The 20 px (0-1.5) and 28 px (1.5-3.5) boundaries stay fixed in samples. The block-1 freeze stays at 0.8 of the new total samples (260000), and the lr warmup/decay, Muon multiplier and lookahead (t/T)^3 ramp are scaled to samples seen. The final half-epoch uses the first half of that epoch's permutation (E006/E018 practice). Warm up every new partial shape at the moved freeze switch and the new run end for each graph variant, with channels_last tensors in the exact timed layout (E035). Run debug_nan.py on new shapes and compare trial-0 with later-trial times.
